+---
+- name: create collection upgrade directory
+  file:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade/ansible_collections'
+    state: directory
+
+- name: install an older collection for upgrade
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1:0.0.1 -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade/ansible_collections'
+
+- name: upgrade to newest stable collection within a constraint
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U 'namespace1.name1:<1.1.0' -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade/ansible_collections'
+  register: upgraded_collection
+
+- name: read upgraded collection manifest
+  slurp:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade/ansible_collections/namespace1/name1/MANIFEST.json'
+  register: upgraded_manifest
+
+- name: verify stable upgrade
+  assert:
+    that:
+      - "(upgraded_manifest.content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '1.0.9'"
+      - "'namespace1.name1:1.0.9' in upgraded_collection.stdout"
+
+- name: repeat collection upgrade
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install --upgrade 'namespace1.name1:<1.1.0' -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade/ansible_collections'
+  register: repeated_upgrade
+
+- name: verify repeated upgrade does not reinstall
+  assert:
+    that:
+      - "'Installing' not in repeated_upgrade.stdout"
+
+- name: upgrade with prereleases enabled
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install --upgrade --pre namespace1.name1 -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade/ansible_collections'
+
+- name: read prerelease upgrade manifest
+  slurp:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade/ansible_collections/namespace1/name1/MANIFEST.json'
+  register: prerelease_upgrade_manifest
+
+- name: verify prerelease upgrade
+  assert:
+    that:
+      - "(prerelease_upgrade_manifest.content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '1.1.0-beta.1'"
+
+- name: write collection upgrade requirements
+  copy:
+    dest: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade/requirements.yml'
+    content: |
+      collections:
+        - name: namespace1.name1
+          version: '<1.0.0'
+        - name: namespace2.name
+
+- name: upgrade collections from requirements file
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install --upgrade -r '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade/requirements.yml' -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade/ansible_collections'
+
+- name: read requirements upgrade manifests
+  slurp:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade/ansible_collections/{{ item.namespace }}/{{ item.name }}/MANIFEST.json'
+  loop:
+    - { namespace: namespace1, name: name1 }
+    - { namespace: namespace2, name: name }
+  register: requirements_upgrade_manifests
+
+- name: verify requirements upgrade respects all constraints
+  assert:
+    that:
+      - "(requirements_upgrade_manifests.results[0].content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '0.1.0'"
+      - "(requirements_upgrade_manifests.results[1].content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '1.0.0'"
+
+- name: install an outdated dependency
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install child_dep.child_collection:0.4.0 --no-deps -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade/ansible_collections'
+
+- name: upgrade a collection with transitive dependencies

+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('allow_pre_release, expected', [(False, '1.0.0'), (True, '1.1.0-beta.1')])
+def test_upgrade_installed_collection(galaxy_server, monkeypatch, tmp_path, allow_pre_release, expected):
+    installed = [Candidate('namespace.collection', '0.9.0', None, 'dir')]
+    monkeypatch.setattr(collection, 'find_existing_collections', lambda *args: installed)
+    mock_install = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(collection, 'install', mock_install)
+    galaxy_server.get_collection_versions = MagicMock(return_value=['0.9.0', '1.0.0', '1.1.0-beta.1'])
+    galaxy_server.get_collection_version_metadata = MagicMock(side_effect=lambda ns, name, ver:
+        api.CollectionVersionMetadata(ns, name, ver, None, None, {}))
+    manager = collection.concrete_artifact_manager.ConcreteArtifactsManager(to_text(tmp_path), validate_certs=False)
+    requirements = [Requirement('namespace.collection', '*', None, 'galaxy')]
+
+    collection.install_collections(requirements, to_text(tmp_path), [galaxy_server], False, True,
+                                   False, False, allow_pre_release, manager, upgrade=True)
+    assert mock_install.call_count == 1
+    assert mock_install.call_args[0][0].ver == expected
+
+    installed[0] = Candidate('namespace.collection', expected, None, 'dir')
+    mock_install.reset_mock()
+    collection.install_collections(requirements, to_text(tmp_path), [galaxy_server], False, True,
+                                   False, False, allow_pre_release, manager, upgrade=True)
+    mock_install.assert_not_called()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('installed_dep, expected_dep', [('1.0.0', '1.0.0'), ('0.9.0', '1.0.0')])
+def test_upgrade_resolves_only_needed_dependencies(galaxy_server, monkeypatch, tmp_path,
+                                                   installed_dep, expected_dep):
+    versions = {'namespace.parent': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0'], 'namespace.child': ['0.9.0', '1.0.0', '1.1.0']}
+    galaxy_server.get_collection_versions = MagicMock(side_effect=lambda ns, name: versions[ns + '.' + name])
+    galaxy_server.get_collection_version_metadata = MagicMock(side_effect=lambda ns, name, ver:
+        api.CollectionVersionMetadata(ns, name, ver, None, None,
+                                      {'namespace.child': '>=1.0.0,<1.1.0'} if name == 'parent' else {}))
+    manager = collection.concrete_artifact_manager.ConcreteArtifactsManager(to_text(tmp_path), validate_certs=False)
+    manager.get_direct_collection_dependencies = MagicMock(return_value={})
+    installed = {Candidate('namespace.parent', '1.0.0', None, 'dir'),
+                 Candidate('namespace.child', installed_dep, None, 'dir')}
+    requirements = [Requirement('namespace.parent', '*', None, 'galaxy')]
+
+    result = collection._resolve_depenency_map(requirements, [galaxy_server], manager, installed,
+                                               False, False, upgrade=True)
+    assert result['namespace.parent'].ver == '2.0.0'
+    assert result['namespace.child'].ver == expected_dep
+
+
+def test_upgrade_respects_constraint_and_no_deps(galaxy_server, tmp_path):
+    galaxy_server.get_collection_versions = MagicMock(return_value=['1.0.0', '2.0.0'])
+    galaxy_server.get_collection_version_metadata = MagicMock(side_effect=lambda ns, name, ver:
+        api.CollectionVersionMetadata(ns, name, ver, None, None, {}))
+    manager = collection.concrete_artifact_manager.ConcreteArtifactsManager(to_text(tmp_path), validate_certs=False)
+    requirements = [Requirement('namespace.collection', '<2.0.0', None, 'galaxy')]
+    result = collection._resolve_depenency_map(requirements, [galaxy_server], manager, None,
+                                               True, False, upgrade=True)
+    assert result['namespace.collection'].ver == '1.0.0'
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('flag', ['-U', '--upgrade'])
+def test_cli_passes_upgrade_to_collection_install(flag, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    mock_install = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr('ansible.cli.galaxy.install_collections', mock_install)
+    cli = GalaxyCLI(args=['ansible-galaxy', 'collection', 'install', flag,
+                          'namespace.collection', '-p', to_text(tmp_path)])
+    cli.run()
+    assert mock_install.call_args[1]['upgrade'] is True
+
+
+def test_cli_passes_upgrade_for_requirements_file(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    requirements_file = tmp_path / 'requirements.yml'
+    requirements_file.write_text('collections:\n  - name: namespace.collection\n    version: "<2.0.0"\n')
+    mock_install = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr('ansible.cli.galaxy.install_collections', mock_install)
+    cli = GalaxyCLI(args=['ansible-galaxy', 'collection', 'install', '--upgrade',
+                          '-r', to_text(requirements_file), '-p', to_text(tmp_path)])
+    cli.run()
+    assert mock_install.call_args[1]['upgrade'] is True
+    assert mock_install.call_args[0][0][0].ver == '<2.0.0'

+def test_upgrade_installed_collection(galaxy_server, monkeypatch, tmp_path, allow_pre_release, expected):

+        api.CollectionVersionMetadata(ns, name, ver, None, None, {}))
+    manager = collection.concrete_artifact_manager.ConcreteArtifactsManager(to_text(tmp_path), validate_certs=False)
+    requirements = [Requirement('namespace.collection', '*', None, 'galaxy')]

+    collection.install_collections(requirements, to_text(tmp_path), [galaxy_server], False, True,

+def test_upgrade_resolves_only_needed_dependencies(galaxy_server, monkeypatch, tmp_path,
+                                                   installed_dep, expected_dep):
+    versions = {'namespace.parent': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0'], 'namespace.child': ['0.9.0', '1.0.0', '1.1.0']}
+    galaxy_server.get_collection_versions = MagicMock(side_effect=lambda ns, name: versions[ns + '.' + name])
+    galaxy_server.get_collection_version_metadata = MagicMock(side_effect=lambda ns, name, ver:
+        api.CollectionVersionMetadata(ns, name, ver, None, None,
+                                      {'namespace.child': '>=1.0.0,<1.1.0'} if name == 'parent' else {}))
+    manager = collection.concrete_artifact_manager.ConcreteArtifactsManager(to_text(tmp_path), validate_certs=False)
+    manager.get_direct_collection_dependencies = MagicMock(return_value={})
+    installed = {Candidate('namespace.parent', '1.0.0', None, 'dir'),
+                 Candidate('namespace.child', installed_dep, None, 'dir')}
+    requirements = [Requirement('namespace.parent', '*', None, 'galaxy')]
+
+    result = collection._resolve_depenency_map(requirements, [galaxy_server], manager, installed,
+                                               False, False, upgrade=True)
+    assert result['namespace.parent'].ver == '2.0.0'
+    assert result['namespace.child'].ver == expected_dep
